summary: Over 5 years of software developer experience, working with enterprise-level applications (banks and insurance companies). Excellent team player who encourages a collaborative knowledge-sharing environment to deliver quality results. Experienced with building end-to-end applications and software infrastructure.

bullets: Led and contributed to two production systems—a call analysis SaaS platform and a trading card marketplace API—across both codebases and infrastructure.
Built AI-driven transcription and insight pipelines for call centers.
Adopted **AI-driven development** workflows with tools like **Claude Code** to accelerate feature delivery and code review.
Delivered gamification features (leaderboards, achievements) to drive user engagement.
Built REST API for trading card marketplace aggregating multi-source pricing data.
Designed automated ingestion pipelines, search indexing, and cron-based synchronization.
Managed GCP infrastructure (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines with automated testing and monitoring.
Collaborated with company leadership to design and automate the company's HR system infrastructure, optimizing data flows and eliminating tens of hours of overhead reporting each week.
Developed reusable **internal tools** and libraries, streamlining internal development by providing standardized service interfaces and reducing the need for boilerplate code.
Developed secure login infrastructure for a cross-platform mobile banking application, including challenge authentication, one-time password login, and **session management**.

Rebuilt legacy banking **REST API** services spanning over 200 endpoints, and modernized legacy browser and mobile banking applications using **Angular/Ionic** and **Express** frameworks to meet evolving system requirements.
Implemented **state management** patterns using **Redux** to maintain consistency and performance across the banking frontend application.
Established test environments and conducted thorough **unit** and **end-to-end testing** to meet the banking client's requirement of **90% test coverage** across feature capabilities.
Provided **technical leadership** to team members through training and ongoing developer support on the banking application team.
Collaborated with UI designers to build a **reusable global component library** in **Storybook**, improving consistency and efficiency across banking client applications.

**Saved QA teams hundred of hours per week** by building automated **Python** scripts to parse and sort application logs for a phone interactive voice response banking application, replacing manual log searches.

Developed and presented a proof-of-concept **React** app for a real estate application that lets users search for properties and view property details, designing the UI architecture and leading the team's design pattern implementation.
Worked in **Agile** teams to define and implement user stories and tasks across client engagements.
Architect and maintain an **open-source Nx monorepo** containing full-stack web apps, API services, shared reusable **npm** libraries, developer notes, and infrastructure code.
Design and run **agentic coding workflows** with **Claude Code**, building custom skills and slash commands for code review, refactor cleanup, documentation upkeep, and automated PR authoring.
Provision and operate **cloud infrastructure** with **Terraform**, managing secrets through dedicated secret managers.
Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** covering PR checks, health checks, cron jobs, and smoke, end-to-end, and security test suites across a growing set of apps and services.

soft: Excellent communication and active listening skills, able to explain technical ideas in a clear and simple manner.
Strong team player who is always open for discussions and collective collaboration.
